title: Ehomaki German Caramel Hazelnut Kisseled Dessert
description: A unique dessert that combines the richness of caramel and hazelnuts with the crunch of Japanese ehomaki and a touch of German kissed flavor.
instructions: 2. Spread the chopped hazelnuts on a baking sheet and toast for 5 minutes.
3. Melt the caramel sauce in a saucepan over low heat.
4. Crush the ehomaki into small pieces and mix with the melted caramel sauce.
5. In a separate bowl, melt the kissed chocolate in the microwave in 30-second increments until smooth.
6. Dip the toasted hazelnuts into the melted chocolate to coat.
7. Dip the ehomaki-caramel mixture into the melted chocolate as well.
8. Place the coated ehomaki pieces on a parchment-lined baking sheet and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
